title: drain_once_for_test should be pub(crate) #[cfg(test)] not #[doc(hidden)] pub
description: drain_once_for_test is declared as #[doc(hidden)] pub. This still makes it part of the crate's public API surface — downstream code outside the crate can call it, and semver tools will track it. The idiomatic Rust pattern for a test-helper method on a public type is pub(crate) with no cfg(test) (so integration tests in the same crate can call it) or pub #[cfg(test)] if only unit tests need it. #[doc(hidden)] is a documentation workaround, not a visibility restriction.
